outcome: maternal vital organ function (lungs, kidneys, liver)
fetal vital organ function (kidneys, liver, placentas)
maternal blood laboratory parameters (amylase, hemoglobin, platelet count)
cohort: Forty pregnant EPM 1 Wistar rats were randomly allocated into four groups (control and three enfuvirtide dose groups).
finding: Enfuvirtide administration during pregnancy in rats had no significant adverse effects on pregnancy, conceptual products, or functional alterations in maternal rats, though high doses were associated with lower maternal weight and some maternal pulmonary inflammation.
